recommended_description: Recommended mode configures IBus only when it is available and allowed by policy; it never automatically selects evdev or another globally observing path.

routes.label: IBus
routes.setup_detail: toolkit-aware committed text with password/PIN purpose support; no raw keyboard access

routes.label: Maximum compatibility
routes.setup_detail: evdev capture with libei output; password-field awareness is unavailable

routes.label: Evdev + wlroots
routes.setup_detail: evdev capture with wlroots virtual-keyboard output; password-field awareness is unavailable

routes.label: Input Method v2
routes.setup_detail: exclusive text capture; unsupported-key pass-through and compositor behavior require certification
